gloss: charm; taste; artistic sentiment; refined atmosphere

definitions.gloss: charm; taste; refined atmosphere; artistic sentiment
definitions.explanation: An elegant or emotionally evocative quality that appeals to one's aesthetic sensibility. Used to describe the subtle beauty, mood, or emotional resonance of a scene, object, or experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of charm in the old townscape.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This garden has its own charm in each of the four seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}けた→生ける：10667_ikeru⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えている→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: The flowers arranged in the Japanese-style room add an elegant touch to the space.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧ (emotion, feeling) and {趣|しゅ} (taste, charm). Describes a refined, emotionally resonant quality — the kind of subtle beauty that evokes feeling and appreciation. It is closely related to the Japanese aesthetic sensibility of appreciating mood and atmosphere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have charm/atmosphere
- {情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the charm
- {情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be rich in charm
- {情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to add charm/atmosphere
- {情趣|じょうしゅ}⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な: rich in charm and sentiment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧: elegance, atmosphere — very similar; ⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧ often emphasizes the visual or environmental impression, while {情趣|じょうしゅ} emphasizes the emotional resonance
- ⟦{趣|おもむき}→趣：09072_omomuki⟧: taste, elegance, flavor — broader and can be used more casually; {情趣|じょうしゅ} is more literary
- {風雅|ふうが}: refined elegance — more elevated and literary, often associated with classical arts and poetry

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Commonly used in travel writing, literary criticism, and descriptions of traditional Japanese culture. Less common in casual everyday conversation.
